heroText: Feel safe with our alarm and surveillance systems that you can monitor from your phone wherever you are.
featureText: Systems for door opening by fingerprint, code, NFC, recording each access, local or remote opening.
featureCard1Text: Forgetting keys is a thing of the past, with our smart locks you can enter your home accurately and securely just by placing your finger on the reader.
featureCard2Text: Lock your locks even if you are not at home with our mobile application.
featureCard3Text: Say goodbye to that "Wait, did I close the door this morning?" moment thanks to Smart Lock's auto-lock feature. The grosocopio and the geomagnetic chip detect when your door is unlocked and activate the lock after a set time.
